title: Prygin's Weapons
description: This mod adds a wide variety of guns and other weapons to the game, along with building blocks and resources.
body:
# Welcome to Prygin's Weapons
This mod aims to enhance the PVP experience in Minecraft. To do so, it adds a wide variety of guns, melee, and ranged weapons. In addition, it adds a handful of different blocks to also improve the looks of the arenas you plan on initiating combat.
## Current Features
### Items:
- Minigun & Ammo
- Pistol & Ammo
- Watergun & Cartridge
- Cybercannon
- Zombie Scythe
- Ninja Star
### Blocks
- Wooden Floorboard Blocks
- Block of Titanium

The guns break certain blocks when they are shot, and all zombies have a simple emerging animation. In addition, all guns have decals when shot.
